summary: MyMangaDB is a self-hosted manager designed for organising physical or digital manga collections. It features automated metadata retrieval, options to import existing lists from MyAnimeList, and generated statistics detailing your reading habits.
goodFor: It suits comic and manga enthusiasts who want a dedicated, local database to track their reading progress and library inventory rather than using generic spreadsheet tools.
watchOut: Given the modest repository activity and niche feature set, development pace may be slow and troubleshooting uncommon edge cases will likely fall on you.
deployNotes: Since it relies on Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volume mounts to retain your database and cover art, alongside a reverse proxy if you want secure external access.
